characters.description: Ken Nagato narrates the series. He is a first-year at Halen whose rare Emperor class comes with a sealed Demon Lord as its secondary class. When the book opens he is level 5, his skills include Absorb, Discharge and Dark Blades, and his party has just defeated its first boss. He leads a group made up of his partners Fayeth, Dez and Charlotte, along with Harley and Charlotte's rabbit, Bun Bun. He has also agreed to help rebuild the Nagato clan of assassins, a life his late mother chose to leave. His grandmother drives the party to the family estate for two weeks of training.
characters.name: Ken Nagato

characters.description: Ken's instructor at Halen and his patron, a very high-level adventurer who is personally invested in how fast he grows. She comes with the party to the Nagato estate and shares a house with Ken during the training stay. She and the elven royal censor dislike each other openly, and Crimson boasts that she once broke the censor's sword. Ken's grandfather flirts with her when she arrives.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: An elf and the tank of Ken's party. She says the city under her people's great tree is home to about twenty million elves. She shares an elven partner bond with Ken, which one of his grandmothers and the elven censor both treat as significant, and she moves into his house at the family estate.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: A half-succubus warlock who scouts and fights at range for Ken's party. She is one of Ken's three partners, along with Fayeth and Charlotte, and she helps keep watch over the demonic seal inside him.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: The druid healer of Ken's party and one of his partners. She is partnered with Bun Bun, a rabbit who fights with the group and understands what people say.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: The bard of Ken's party, and the one member who is not also his partner. On arrival at the Nagato estate, grandmother Yui quietly lines up an especially tough training schedule for her.
characters.name: Harley

characters.description: Charlotte's rabbit, who fights with the party. The grandparents tell everyone that he will go through the same hard training as the humans during the stay at the family estate.
characters.name: Bun Bun

characters.description: An elven envoy who serves the elven princess and has been sent to keep an eye on Ken's party. She clashes openly with Crimson and wants to know more about Ken and his team. When Fayeth decides to stay in Ken's house at the estate, the censor goes along with it.
characters.name: The royal censor

characters.description: One of Ken's grandmothers. She drives the party to the walled family estate and sets its house rules, including a ban on weapons inside any of the houses. She comes across as kind while planning brutal training, especially for Harley.
characters.name: Yui

characters.description: Ken's biological grandmother, one of several grandmothers living at the Nagato estate. She is there when the party arrives and backs the plan to put everyone through demanding training.
characters.name: Sakura

characters.description: One of Ken's grandmothers, present in person when the party reaches the Nagato estate. She is a very big woman with the muscular build of a bodybuilder.
characters.name: Akari

characters.description: Ken's grandfather, who runs the Nagato estate together with Ken's grandmothers. He has a teasing streak and flirts with Crimson when she arrives. He and the grandmothers want the party prepared to fight off hostile adventurers.
characters.name: Ken's grandfather

characters.description: The elven royal who sent the censor to Ken. Crimson tells Ken that the princess does not truly have the class she claims, and Ken already knew it. He is meant to visit her after he reaches level 20, and he may share his Absorb skill with her.
characters.name: The elven princess

characters.description: One of Ken's grandmothers, separate from Yui, Sakura and Akari, and the one Ken regards as the warmest toward him. She is away when the party first reaches the estate. During Ken's test in the family dungeon, her banner flags keep monsters away from his spot on floor 5 for a time. When he finally comes out after about three days, she is there to greet him and tells him the flags stopped working on purpose.
characters.name: The banner grandmother

characters.description: Head of the Nagato family's retainers. He meets Ken as the clan starts hiring again for the first time in ten years, and he explains how the clan runs on tasks and points while still paying real wages. He also tells Ken that his mother disliked killing and thought the clan was no longer needed.
characters.name: Hiroshi

characters.description: Charlotte's gray-haired father, a guild leader. After Charlotte's sister Rachel phones her, he joins by video and agrees to come visit the Nagato estate.
characters.name: Marcus

characters.description: Charlotte's sister. She calls Charlotte while the party is at the Nagato estate and makes no secret of her hostility toward Ken.
characters.name: Rachel

characters.description: Hiroshi's daughter, a quiet damage dealer who is one of the young recruits Ken meets at the clan store. She tells him the clan only kills people who have earned it. When two of the recruits attack Ken in a hallway, Amy blocks Fred's blade and takes a deep wound.
characters.name: Amy

characters.description: A level 7 tank who is one of the young recruits at the clan store, and Meg's brother. His family used to serve the clan and came back because Ken is Crimson's protege. He joins his sister in attacking Ken, Amy takes a deep wound blocking his blade, and he runs once Ken fights back.
characters.name: Fred

characters.description: A poison-casting Venomancer among the recruits at the clan store, and Fred's sister. She flirts with Ken, then corners him in a hallway and knocks out the two men with him using a bolt. Ken cancels her poison with Absorb, and she runs off with Fred, both shouting that a demon is on the attack.
characters.name: Meg

characters.description: The head of Halen. Crimson pays her to send everyone back to the academy from the family estate by portal.
characters.name: The headmistress

characters.description: A senior caster whom Ken and Dez notice in the dorm lobby after they return to Halen. They know her from the first party of the hostile student whose group Ken killed, where she appeared to be that student's subordinate or bodyguard. They suspect she is connected to the rival assassin clan and decide to raise it with Crimson.
characters.name: The upperclass caster

characters.description: A level 7 frost knight on Halen's Security Council. When a confrontation breaks out at the dorm entrance over Ken being there, she steps in and lets his group through.
characters.name: Penelope

characters.description: A paladin on Halen's Security Council with fiery hair. She objects to Ken entering the dorm and stands in his way at the door until Dez throws her.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A student in Crimson's class who runs her own party, which includes a healer. She attends Crimson's lessons alongside Ken's party.
characters.name: Kendra

characters.description: A student in Crimson's class who attends lessons alongside Kendra and Ken's party.
characters.name: Taylor

characters.description: The head of the United Guilds, a scarred summoner with a cluttered office full of secured files, who defers to Crimson. Together they give Ken a classified file on research into teleporting between dungeon safe zones. The file shows that the upperclass caster is assisting the research team on the tenth floor. The president is uneasy about her parent.
characters.name: The United Guilds president

characters.description: A thin, platinum-blonde student who leads a rival party in Crimson's class. Her arcane weaver class lets her shape mana into many different weaves. She challenges Ken's party to race to the floor-5 safe zone, and Dez quietly takes a side bet with her on undisclosed terms.
characters.name: The rival party leader

characters.description: A level 22 mage who runs a paid power-leveling guild from another city. Its customers pay to gain levels for health or job benefits. At the seventh-floor scorpion event he claims the eastern half for his guild with flags. He looks after his clients, stays neutral with the Halen students, and notices that Ken is Crimson's protege.
characters.name: Roger

characters.description: A rich online personality, only level 3, who pays for the power-leveling guild's level-20 clients at the scorpion event. She takes an epic wand from the loot and then gives it to Kendra in exchange for a future interview with Ken. She knows his family is a known assassin clan, and she has a crush on him.
characters.name: The influencer

characters.description: Charlotte's mother, a well-known and strict fighter whose class controls storms. At first she banned Charlotte from adventuring and only gave in reluctantly. Charlotte's view that healers only put off the inevitable came from her.
characters.name: Charlotte's mother

characters.description: A level-45 incubus demon lord sealed inside Ken. He visits Ken in a dream, swelling until the chains of the seal strain, and asks for magazines, offering power and training in exchange. He says he gave Ken the Charm skill and some stats, and Ken suspects he is holding back how much power he still has.
characters.name: Snoo

characters.description: Penelope's cousin, a blue-haired girl who flirts with Harley.
characters.name: Meredith

characters.description: A scientist in Halen's dungeon research labs with frizzy black hair. She has built a synthetic skill book that opens portals between tenth-floor safe zones, but learning it wiped the stats of the prison volunteers who tried. She is an idealist who does not want the technology used for war, and she plans a full demonstration at the end-of-year celebration. Her CID is fused into a band that the United Guilds tracks.
characters.name: Dr. Finley

characters.description: A student mage with black hair and blue eyes who helps in Dr. Finley's lab on weekends by filling its batteries with mana. Ken recognizes her as the upperclass caster who supported the hostile student and the anti-elf front. She says the portal technology could favor the strong and calls the prison volunteers expendable. Ken suspects she belongs to the rival assassin clan.
characters.name: Dr. Finley's lab assistant

characters.description: Helen's red-haired mother, a powerful adventurer known as the Harem Queen. She is one of the elite parents who gather at the dungeon entrance for Dr. Finley's end-of-year portal demonstration.
characters.name: Helen's mother

characters.description: A ten-foot, six-armed female Naga whose red scales turn blue toward her tail. She is the first creature through Dr. Finley's portal, and her shockwave levels nearby buildings. She can cast six spells at once and heal herself, and she kills a level 53 fighter of the White Tigers guild in close combat before Crimson attacks her and drives her back from the portal.
characters.name: The six-armed Naga

characters.description: A masked fighter sent by the rival assassin clan as reinforcement when Ken's party corners the lab assistant at the floor-6 exit. He is a little higher in level than Ken and has a venomous, viper-like striking ability. He puts a knife to Charlotte and cuts her throat. Ken and Fayeth defeat him, and Fayeth stabs him to death.
characters.name: The masked assassin

characters.description: Narrator and head of the Nagato clan, a human student adventurer at level 13. During the Naga incident he absorbed a synthetic portal spellbook and used it to shut the portal, but the Portal skill it gave him now shows as restricted. He turns down the harem queen's offer and agrees to spend the summer in the elven world, drawing the people who want his ability away from home while Crimson tries to find her way back.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: An elf tank who fights with shield and spear, and Ken's bonded partner. She is carried out of the dungeon with him after the Naga incident and goes with Ken, Amy and the royal censor to the elven world for the summer.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: Ken's instructor, a ferocious fighter whose Limit Break state is hard for her to rein in. During the Naga incident she went through a portal into Naga territory, and she is stranded there as the book opens. Part of Ken's reason for leaving Earth for the summer is to buy her time to return.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: A silver-haired elf with a ponytail who serves as a royal censor and is one of the strongest fighters on the scene. She carries Ken and Fayeth out of the dungeon, beats the harem queen in a duel, and takes on the job of escorting and protecting Ken during his summer in the elven world.
characters.name: The royal censor

characters.description: Helen's mother, a red-haired fighter who carries a sword wreathed in blue flame. She chases Ken out of the dungeon and offers him the top place in her harem because of the portal spellbook he absorbed. When he says no, she loses a duel to the royal censor and pulls back, insisting he will come to her in the end. She is later allowed to supervise Helen.
characters.name: The harem queen

characters.description: A member of Ken's circle and the harem queen's daughter. To avoid being taken home by her mother, she adopts a cover story suggested by Dez, publicly declaring that she loves Ken and writes an online smut serial about him. The ploy lets her stay: she joins the Silverfangs, with her mother permitted to oversee her.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A masked, white-haired member of the Nagato clan, assigned to Ken as an ally by one of his grandmothers. She joins Ken, Fayeth and the royal censor on the journey to the elven world and stays close to him as his attendant.
characters.name: Amy

characters.description: One of Ken's grandmothers, a healer able to move as mist. She travels with the group for the first stretch of the descent toward the elven world before turning back.
characters.name: Yui

characters.description: A druid healer among Ken's fellow students. When the families arrange intensive summer training at the Nagato estate, aiming to push the students to level 20 before their second year, Charlotte asks to take part and her mother agrees. She remains on Earth while Ken leaves for the elven world.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: Charlotte's mother, a mage who commands storms. She is present at the dungeon exit after the Naga incident and gives her consent for Charlotte to join the accelerated summer training the families organize at the Nagato estate.
characters.name: Charlotte's mother

characters.description: A half-demon member of Ken's group whose family is responsible for the demon sealed inside him. After the Naga incident her father leads the push to fast-track the students' growth over the summer, and she is the one who proposes Helen's cover story so Helen can stay rather than go home with her mother.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: A white-haired woman of a cat-eared tribal race, marked with blue tiger stripes, whom Ken meets in the floor 45 safe zone. A shaman traveling with a protective leopard-spotted guard, she sits down with Ken uninvited, questions him, and is taken with his scent, yet will not explain how her people make use of the dungeon.
characters.name: The cat-people shaman

characters.description: The emperor's red-haired, blue-eyed daughter, an isolated young elf with few if any friends. She is a distant cousin and childhood friend of Fayeth. She hopes to gain Ken's Absorb ability and hosts him and Fayeth as if they were family.
characters.name: The elf princess

characters.description: A royal censor ranked just below the head of the princess's guard. Watching Ken train in the palace gym, she studies his Nagato sword style and correctly guesses that assassins taught him. She is fiercely protective of the princess and had bowed to Ken after the welcome dinner.
characters.name: The second-ranking censor

characters.description: Fayeth's mother, a warm and very outspoken elf whose husband works as an ambassador in another world. On meeting Ken she teases him with blunt questions and is alarmed to hear that Crimson is his teacher, given the rumors about Crimson, but she quickly declares that she is adopting him as a son and plans to cook him dinner.
characters.name: Fayeth's mother

characters.description: Ruler of the elves and the princess's father. He presented his daughter to the public as a prophesied hero. He has turned floors 61 to 65 of the dungeon into sealed minefields because the route to the Naga lies beneath them, a move that has angered elite elves, and there is talk that he may abdicate in her favor.
characters.name: The emperor

characters.description: One of the princess's royal censors. On the party's first dive through the royal family's private entrance, she uses a teleport-like ability to move everyone from the grassland of the first floor to a red-rock zone containing an orc village, where the princess shows Ken how she really fights.
characters.name: The teleporting censor

characters.description: The arrogant heir of a powerful ducal house, strong enough to stand up to the royal censor. He barges into the princess's training zone with high-level companions, demands a spar, sneers at Ken as a mere human, and claims the princess will soon be engaged to him. She denies it and he storms off. His house once governed three great trees, lost two in a tax scandal, and has since won one back.
characters.name: The younger duke

characters.description: Father of the younger duke, holding the same ducal title. Together they lead a large bloc of dukes and top adventurers opposed to the emperor, whose main demand is that the closed upper dungeon floors be reopened. A marriage between his son and the princess would expose her false class.
characters.name: The elder duke

characters.description: An older elf with a mustache who directs a wave of crushing killing intent toward the princess's group at the palace ballroom event. Ken steps in front of her and mostly withstands it, though he can tell the man is far beyond his own strength.
characters.name: The mustached elf

characters.description: A noble elf at the palace event who belittles Ken as the princess's pet. After Ken shows her how much metal humans have and casually throw away on Earth, she changes course and asks for a meeting to discuss trade.
characters.name: The duchess

characters.description: The princess's mother, who no longer stands at the emperor's side and has withdrawn from politics because she disapproves of his course. She is described as gentler than her husband, and Ken is promised an introduction to her.
characters.name: The princess's mother

characters.description: Head of an elven adventuring party led by a hooded archer that ambushes Ken's group on the sixth floor. He offers to sell the disguised princess and Fayeth in a duke's new city and turns out to be part of a ring trafficking drugged, declawed cat-people. Cruel but loyal to his own crew, he is a little more skilled in combat than Ken.
characters.name: The slaver leader

characters.description: The owner of a brothel in a neon-lit vice district hidden under the roots of a duke's city. Far stronger than anyone in Ken's party, she buys the disguised princess for a large sum in crystals. Flirtatious and businesslike, she boasts that she will sell anything, information included, and she quickly suspects the princess is more than a lookalike.
characters.name: The brothel madam

characters.description: A level 30 cat-person held captive and forced to work in the hidden vice district. Ken books time with her and proves his connection to the cat-people shaman with clothing that carries the shaman's scent. She agrees to help, and Ken promises that she and the other captives will be sent home.
characters.name: The captive cat-woman

characters.description: A heavyset elf who runs a bar in the hidden district and wields ember magic, stronger than Ken. He is allied with the duke's family and schemes to take over the madam's position. When Ken attacks him he grows more powerful amid the flames, sets his own bar on fire, and pursues Ken after he escapes.
characters.name: The ember mage

characters.description: A tall, thin elf armed with crescent blades who works under the ember mage. Ken overhears the two discussing a book of letters tying the duke to the trafficking, and the lanky elf carries the book off to a safe house.
characters.name: The lanky elf

characters.description: A huge white Naga matriarch commanding an army in a Naga safe zone. When Crimson cuts through dozens of her soldiers, the matriarch strikes her hard with her tail, and Crimson chooses to flee rather than face her directly.
characters.name: The white Naga matriarch

characters.description: A royal censor who fights on the front line and is the strongest brawler among the princess's guards. Her power grows with contracts and money, and the class she advertises is not her real one. She travels with the party as they escort the freed cat-people down through the dungeon.
characters.name: The merchant censor

characters.description: An older cat-person woman with silver in her hair who leads the group waiting in the floor 40 safe zone. She thanks Ken and the elves for returning the freed captives, invites the shaman to lead a ritual in their honor, and blesses Ken as someone with great potential.
characters.name: The cat-people elder

characters.description: The head of the UG, who is visibly afraid of Crimson and gives way to her. After she gets a new CID, the president brings her up to date on Ken closing the portal, the greed his ability stirred up, and his departure for the elven world, and asks her not to kill the harem queen.
characters.name: The UG president

characters.description: A royal censor able to change her face. During the plan to slip into the seized palace she takes on the mustached elf's appearance to help the infiltrators, then stays behind to guard the entrance.
characters.name: The shapeshifting censor

recaps.ending: The coup is over and the house behind it is finished: the younger duke dies at the wedding, and his father, crippled there, is beheaded in the throne room, while the rebels' supporters are sent to fight the Naga. The princess governs as acting regent and is publicly bound to Ken, sharing Absorb and Spell Mirror with him through their harmony; her own claimed hero class still rests on borrowed effects. She promises to join Ken on Earth once her father's war is won. The emperor, now holding the front until floor 65 is retaken, grudgingly values ties with humans but still seems to dislike the match. A metal supply contract of at least a million metric tons links the Nagato clan to a blue-haired duchess, with the head censor as liaison. The captive empress mentioned during the coup is not accounted for. Crimson is back as Ken's trainer and apparent partner, with partial command over Limit Break that Ken can switch off by voice. Ken, stronger and carrying Hydra and Blessing of the Dungeon, can use Portal inside the dungeon but still cannot open portals, and others continue to covet the ability. He and Fayeth head home for their second year, where Dez (level 25), Charlotte (level 21) and Helen wait at the Nagato estate. The harem queen remains alive, punished and interested in Ken, and the cat-people shaman is among several other suitors. A human faction working with the Naga, a rival clan, his parents' betrayal and the sealed demon all remain open.
recaps.in_short: With Crimson lost in Naga territory and powerful adventurers chasing his new portal power, Ken spends the summer in the elven world under a royal censor's protection, bringing Fayeth and Amy, while his friends train at the Nagato estate. The elf princess, whose hero class is a lie staged by her father, courts him openly, and Ken accepts her into his household alongside Fayeth despite the emperor's hostility. Hunting evidence against a scheming ducal house, Ken goes undercover among slavers, kills two of the house's agents, turns a fugitive former censor into a witness, and frees captive cat-people; the duke is condemned and the princess publicly chooses Ken. Crimson fights her way out of the Naga floors, while the cat-people shaman's ritual unlocks Ken's Portal inside the dungeon. The ducal house then seizes the palace while the emperor is at the Naga front. Ken kills the younger duke in an infiltration, but the group is captured and the princess is to be forced into marriage. Crimson arrives, the wedding is turned into a rout, the usurper is executed, and the princess pledges herself to Ken as acting regent. Crimson destroys a Naga army and its white matriarch, Ken learns he can command her Limit Break to stop, and he leaves with Fayeth for his second school year.

recaps.text: Previously: Ken Nagato is a student adventurer and head of the Nagato clan, whose grandparents are assassins who keep him sharp with surprise attacks. He trains under Crimson, an immensely powerful instructor whose berserk Limit Break state is difficult for her to control. His circle includes his elf partner Fayeth, the druid healer Charlotte, the half-demon Dez, and Helen. Dez's family sealed a level 45 demon inside Ken, which gave him a secondary Demon Lord class. The previous book ended with the Naga incident: a portal opened toward Naga territory, Crimson went through it while deep in Limit Break and vanished, and Ken absorbed a synthetic portal spellbook and used its power to close the gateway. That feat has made his new ability something strong adventurers want for themselves. Several older matters also remain unsettled, including a rival clan, his parents' betrayal, and the demon sealed within him.

So far this book: An elven royal censor carries Ken and Fayeth out of the dungeon after the Naga incident. Helen's mother, the harem queen, pursues them and offers Ken the head place in her harem; he refuses, the censor defeats her in a duel, and she backs off for now. Ken's Portal skill is marked restricted, and Crimson is stranded among the Naga. To pull pursuers away and give Crimson time, Ken decides to spend the summer in the elven world with the censor, Fayeth and Amy, a masked Nagato clan member who insists she is his butler. Back home, the families plan intensive training at the Nagato estate aimed at level 20 before second year. Charlotte joins, Dez takes on demon blood to grow her class, and Helen stays by pretending to love Ken and write a smut serial about him, joining the Silverfangs.

The censor power-levels the party on the descent, and Ken's grandmother Yui travels with them as far as floor 50. In the floor 45 safe zone a cat-people shaman takes an interest in Ken, sleeps beside him, guesses his tie to Crimson, and leaves after Amy trades his dirty clothes; the skill book she offered teaches Amy a stealth skill.

In the elven capital Ken meets the princess, Fayeth's cousin and old friend. Her hero class is a fiction staged by her father, the emperor; she is actually an Eidolon Priest, and she wants Ken's Absorb ability, which would require genuine soul harmony. She flirts openly; Ken insists he will judge her by her actions, while Fayeth encourages him to let her in. The emperor has sealed floors 61 to 65 against the Naga, angering the elite, and may abdicate. Fayeth's mother meets Ken and adopts him as a son.

So far this book: Through the royal family's private dungeon entrance, the princess shows her true fighting style, taking on monster forms such as a minotaur and a hydra that replace her own abilities. The younger duke, heir of a house that once ruled three great trees, interrupts with high-level allies, insults Ken, and claims the princess will marry him; she refuses. Fayeth's mother learns that the princess intends to present Ken as the human holder of the revered elven class and approves of the princess joining his household. She also explains the politics: several dukes, led by the younger duke and his father, have formed a bloc against the emperor and want the upper floors reopened. Ken realizes a marriage into that house would expose the princess's false class.

In the royal library the princess helps Ken choose a dark area-damage skill that spreads blades in a wide arc, gives him the book, and kisses him; he agrees to try for a shared household, and Fayeth approves. Meanwhile Crimson surfaces after about a week of nonstop Limit Break on a deep Naga floor, her CID broken, holding herself together by thinking of Ken.

At a palace ball the princess presents Ken to the dukes. He turns a duchess's insult into interest in a metal trade, plans to supply iron through the Silverfangs, and shields the princess from a mustached elf ranked eighth among elven adventurers. The emperor then forbids the match, calls Ken merely the key to his daughter's cage, says Crimson will probably not return, and predicts elves may one day conquer humans, though he asks Ken to keep her safe. Shaken, Ken grows wary of the princess's motives. The head censor, who turns out to be the emperor's cousin and the princess's relative, advises her to keep courting Ken and reveal her politics gradually.

So far this book: A noble loyal to the duke seals the palace dungeon stairway as a protest. Ken is level 19, his CID cut off from home servers, and the princess explains that Absorb lets harmonized partners share class skills, which are lost if the harmony breaks. Ken tells her he believes she is not using him. Disguised as a servant, the princess enters the public dungeon with Ken, Fayeth and Amy; Ken buys her a blue crystal ring. On floor 6 an elven party ambushes them, offering to sell the servants in the duke's new city, and Ken learns they traffic drugged, declawed cat-people. The princess has secretly hired the Nagato clan to find proof linking the duke to the kidnapping of a noblewoman, so Ken plays along and sells her.

In a hidden vice district under the city a powerful madam buys the princess. A captive cat-woman agrees to help Ken. He kills the slaver leader, overhears an ember-mage bar owner and a lanky elf discussing a book of incriminating letters, fights the mage, and later kills him in a burning building. The madam confronts Ken, sees his Absorb, and works out that the princess's class is false.

The royal censor arrives. The madam proves to be a former royal censor wanted for taking the duke's bribes; she sells the princess back, accepts a five-year contract with her bounty lifted, agrees to testify, and goes with Ken to the safe house, where she kills the lanky elf. Ken's earnings are surrendered in the deal. The district is dismantled, the duke's family is placed under house arrest, and fifteen cat-people are sheltered at the palace. At the trial Ken's truthful testimony holds up, the duke is condemned to death, and the princess tells the jailed younger duke that Ken is the man she will marry.

So far this book: Crimson wakes among Naga corpses, her armor ruined and CID smashed, and dresses in Naga gear. Her Eyes of Wisdom finally reveal a stairway up. A white matriarch's tail blow convinces her to flee, and she picks her way across trapped floors into elf territory and out to a UG branch with Italian-speaking staff, where she demands a new CID.

About a month after the incident, Ken learns in training that Portal works on the elven surface but collapses him from mana drain. Eleven censors escort Ken, the princess, Fayeth, Amy and the fifteen freed cat-people down the royal entrance; the princess invites Ken to share her tent. On floor 40 the cat-people reclaim their kin. Their shaman says the dungeon, which they worship as the Great One, has marked Ken, and her ritual gives him a dagger tattoo showing that Portal now works inside the dungeon at a high mana cost. He also gains Blessing of the Dungeon, and he uses Absorb on the princess.

The UG president tells Crimson that Ken closed the portal and went to the elves, that most of her students are at the Nagato estate, and asks her not to kill the harem queen. A floor 60 report says Crimson passed through and that white Naga have broken through trapped floors. Returning, the party is ambushed at the palace exit by the mustached elf, who announces the duke now holds the throne while the emperor is away; the merchant censor smashes him into the ceiling.

At the estate Crimson finds Charlotte at level 21 and Dez more demonic, then beats and chains the harem queen, demanding skill books for Ken's partners. Ken proposes infiltrating the seized palace; the princess insists on coming, and a shapeshifting censor helps them in.

So far this book: Inside the royal quarters the princess charms a captive duke into revealing that the rebels hold the empress prisoner, then kills him. Ken finds the younger duke in the princess's bed and kills him using Absorb, Spell Mirror and Dark Strike, but the noise brings guards, and the whole group, censors included, is captured. The younger duke's father takes the throne, has healers revive his son, and orders the princess married to him at dawn. One censor who had seemed bought by the rebels appears to defect. That night the princess fights the younger duke off twice with her monster forms.

Crimson reaches Ken's cell, heals him, and they plan to wreck the wedding. She blasts the guards and frees the head censor, and the supposedly bought censor, loyal all along under a contract clause, breaks the usurper's legs. Ken and the princess fight together and kill the younger duke. The princess declares the coup treason and publicly pledges herself to Ken, with Fayeth at their side. As acting regent she has the usurper beheaded and sends his backers to the Naga front, and she brokers a metal deal of at least a million metric tons between a duchess and the Nagato clan. Crimson shows her greatly increased stats and approves of the princess; the princess's mother, wary of the rushed marriage, accepts Ken once he says the emperor asked him to protect her.

Crimson drills Ken hard, and he takes Hydra from the princess. At floor 63 a Naga army led by a white matriarch emerges; at Ken's request Crimson enters a controlled Limit Break, annihilates it, kills the matriarch, and calms down on her own. The emperor thanks them grudgingly and will hold the front until floor 65 is retaken. Ken finds he can order Crimson's Limit Break off. The princess promises to follow after the war, and Ken and Fayeth leave for their second school year.

characters.description: Head of the Nagato clan and guildmaster of Silverfangs, an Emperor-class adventurer with a sealed demon secondary class. He comes back from a summer in the elven world with his party and is about to start his second year at Halen. He has the rare Portal skill but cannot open one himself yet, and the remnants of Kaiming are hunting him.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: Ken's instructor at Halen and a fearsome high-level fighter whose Limit Break turns her berserk. Her new red hair dye failed the moment Limit Break activated. On the way home she admits she deliberately took the blood of the floor-45 demon boss, which is linked to Ken's sealed demon class. She claims her Limit Break came from a floor-28 lightning bird, though Ken suspects she is hiding part of the truth.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: An elf and the party's tank, fighting with a glaive, camouflage and roots. She returns from the elven world with Ken, who swapped skills with her over the summer, and Ken's grandfather treats her as his favorite granddaughter. She takes her duty of keeping Ken safe very seriously.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: Ken's partner and party mage. Over the summer she trained deep in the dungeon with her parents, unlocked a demonic heritage, and changed from warlock to demonic mage with a Temptress secondary class. Her eyes are now pink, and the covered one has a heart-shaped pupil.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: A druid in Ken's party and one of his partners. She spent the summer training hard under her mother and has gained the ability to revive the dead, which makes her the group's safety net. She can understand her rabbit companion and passes on what he says.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: Charlotte's giant rabbit. Over the summer he was retrained as a dodge tank, with skills for taunting, evading and moving quickly, though he still has trouble keeping enemies focused on him.
characters.name: Bun-Bun

characters.description: A masked butler in the service of the Nagato family who looks after Ken and reports back to his grandfather. She travels with the group on the walk home through the dungeon.
characters.name: Amy

characters.description: Ken's grandmother, an elder of the Nagato clan who can teleport inside a cloud of mist. She walks back to the Nagato estate with Ken's party after the summer.
characters.name: Yui

characters.description: Ken's grandfather and an elder of the Nagato clan. He carries Ken to the estate and settles terms with him about leaving Crimson and Ken's class partners alone. He is very fond of Fayeth, and Amy reports to him.
characters.name: Ken's grandfather

characters.description: An elf princess Ken became partnered with during his summer in the elven world, and one of the people he swapped skills with. She stays in her own world, but Ken says he may bring her into his group later.
characters.name: The elf princess

characters.description: Head of the Halen academy. She is stern and dislikes being ordered around by Crimson, but she owes Crimson favors and so agrees to portal Ken's group to school at the last minute.
characters.name: The headmistress

characters.description: Head of the UG. With angel summons backing him, he personally leads the raid that destroys Kaiming's last safe house on the surface.
characters.name: The UG president

characters.description: A senior figure in what remains of Kaiming. He is a caster who uses debuffs and snake venom and can open portals. When the UG takes his last surface safe house, he escapes through a portal into a dungeon and swears to get revenge on Ken.
characters.name: The Kaiming leader

characters.description: A bard in Ken's party, Class 2A, who dreams of having a harem of healers. Her strong mana regeneration is valuable for the coming raid. She finds out that Ken did sleep with the elf princess.
characters.name: Harley

characters.description: A notorious woman with a large harem who joins Halen's staff at the start of the year and takes over a second-year class. Crimson silences her at the entrance ceremony. She is Helen's mother, and her students have already built a luxurious school building on floor 30. Ken has said he wants nothing to do with her.
characters.name: The harem queen

characters.description: A Class 2A tank who has a revive skill, and the daughter of the harem queen. Dez says Helen wrote the smutty serial "74 Wives" to get back at her mother and to get into Silverfangs.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A Class 2A classmate of Ken's who fights as a frost knight tank.
characters.name: Penny

characters.description: A blonde Class 2A student who answers the teachers' questions and whose mother leads a guild. She explains that death rates at the top colleges are expected to climb steeply under the new standards.
characters.name: Candace

characters.description: A Class 2A classmate of Ken's.
characters.name: Taylor

characters.description: A monster that appears only when the dungeon focuses on Ken. It is huge and dark, throws off purple sparks, and teleports. Other attacks pass straight through it, and only Ken's blades can hurt it. When Charlotte heals him, it speeds up and kills him in an instant before disappearing.
characters.name: The panther

characters.description: A cat-people shaman Ken met over the summer. She tattooed him and has a big mane, blue stripes and revealing clothes. Dez bets that she will come looking for him.
characters.name: The cat-people shaman

characters.description: A healer in Candace's party with short black hair, whose skills drain souls. She is the one who suggests Helen's mother as a possible partner for Ken, and the group teases him about it.
characters.name: Selene

characters.description: The tank in Candace's party, fighting with a mace and shield.
characters.name: Myrtle

characters.description: A cocky, strong berserker from a rich family, and the center of the startup party Crimson scouted for when she was young. He lied to the party, and on a candy-themed floor a lightning phoenix drove him into a rage. He killed the mage, and then the phoenix killed him and the healer. Crimson blamed him for the deaths and kept his CID.
characters.name: Rick

characters.description: A blue-haired UG official with glasses and a laptop who runs the safe zone. After the dwarf attack she tells Ken that a dwarf has marked him and asks him to stay out of public areas. She is Selene's mother and says plainly that Selene's father is in prison. She is keeping watch on Ken because of his ties to the elves.
characters.name: The zone director

characters.description: The UG zone director, now known by name. She is blue-haired, Selene's mother, around her mid-forties in level, and not afraid of Crimson. Her husband is in prison as a UG undercover agent working against Kaiming. She works with Crimson to draw out and destroy a gathering of would-be assassins, then announces penalties against those who worked with Kaiming.
characters.name: Director Amato

characters.description: A woman Ken met on floor 7 who was power-leveled to level 40. She has been messaging with Crimson, who invites her to handle public relations for Silverfangs. Ken agrees to it reluctantly.
characters.name: The influencer

characters.description: An elf with a silver ponytail who serves as a courier between worlds. She brings Ken letters from the elf princess along with an errand related to the metal trade.
characters.name: The royal censor

characters.description: An incubus-type demon lord sealed inside Ken, who acts as his secondary class. He is a level-45 boss that the UG restricts, far too strong for Ken to fight alone. He once gave bonus stats in exchange for smut magazines. When Ken meets him in his mindscape, he confirms that Dez's demonic side belongs to her by blood.
characters.name: Snoo-Snoo

characters.description: A healer with Penny's group whose power moves wounds onto enemies. With Penny, she kills an armored soldier dwarf during the defense of Halen.
characters.name: Dolly

characters.description: The harem queen's real name, revealed through her own point of view. She is Helen's mother, a knight of the mythic flame who wields a blue-fire sword, and her harem's bonds boost her stats. She hates being mistaken for Crimson. During the dwarf invasion she leaves Ken in charge of the students and flies off alone to fight the dwarf queen and her guards.
characters.name: Heather

characters.description: The ruler of the invading dwarf hive. She is nearly nine feet tall, speaks English, and wears chitin armor that repairs itself. She is both a tank and a healer, turns captured humans into drones while taking what was in their CIDs, and treats her soldiers as parts of herself. Five elite soldiers guard her.
characters.name: The dwarf queen

recaps.ending: Kaiming is finished: Ken killed its top remaining leader, the mage who fought his grandparents after the plane crash, and his grandparents tell him to look ahead. The smoke panther trial is over, and Ken now has Liminal Speed and Liminal Space, which the UG rates as top tier and uncapped and whose details are now redacted from his records. At level 29 he is aiming for level 30, a leveling event at a vampire-themed spot on floor 28, and the floor-32 inter-school raid against the Royal Academy, Pendulum and Trusk. Crimson is his partner and trainer. She can use Portal and controls her Limit Break better when she is near him, and the grandparents have accepted her. Fayeth, Dez, Charlotte, Bun-Bun and Harley are still in his party. The cat-people shaman lives in his household and has claimed a raid slot. Heather, the harem queen, now respects Ken and is bringing her husbands, Helen's fathers, out of retirement to dive again, which worries Helen. Penny and Selene want a place in Ken's circle, while he says he is still committed to the absent elf princess, who keeps in touch by letter as the metal trade continues. Director Amato and the UG are deferring to Ken. One dwarf queen is dead and her section has been sealed with a fort, but other queens, the dwarves' mark on Ken, and the dungeon's attention on him are all unresolved. Other open questions: who really wrote "74 Wives", how Crimson got Portal, whether Silverfangs will dive or farm, and whether Harley will leave.
recaps.in_short: Ken Nagato returns from the elven world to start his second year at Halen, where second years must reach floor 32 for an inter-school raid or be expelled. A smoke panther that only he can hurt is sent against him as a dungeon trial and kills him four times, and he is revived each time. Meanwhile Crimson reveals that she got her Limit Break from a lightning phoenix, finds she can switch it off at Ken's command, and becomes his lover. Dwarves mark Ken for death. At the panther's last attack, Ken wins its speed race and gains Liminal Speed and Liminal Space, then uses them to kill a Kaiming ambush and its leader, the mage tied to his parents' deaths, which ends Kaiming. The UG judges the ability strong enough to rival Crimson. A dwarf hive then attacks Halen and the dungeon branch. With Crimson away holding floor 25, Ken leads the students, and his time freeze helps the harem queen, Heather, kill the dwarf queen. The section is sealed after more than 200 adventurers die. Ken is wounded and his records are redacted. Once he heals, he heads back to Halen to level toward 30 for the raid.

recaps.text: Previously: Ken Nagato is an Emperor-class adventurer, head of the Nagato clan, and guildmaster of Silverfangs. He finished his first year at the Halen academy with Crimson, a fierce, high-level instructor whose Limit Break drives her into a berserk state. His party includes the elf tank Fayeth, the mage Dez, the druid Charlotte and her giant rabbit Bun-Bun, and the bard Harley. The group lived through a major battle against the Naga, and the criminal organization Kaiming is now on the run. Ken also carries a sealed demon secondary class. He spent the summer in the elven world, where he became the partner of an elf princess, swapped skills with her and with Fayeth, and was tattooed by a shaman of the cat-people. A metal trade with the elves now benefits the Nagato clan. Ken has the rare Portal skill but cannot yet open a portal on his own.

So far this book: Ken, Fayeth, Crimson, Amy and his grandmother Yui travel through the dungeon back to the Nagato estate. Crimson admits she deliberately took the blood of the floor-45 demon boss, which is linked to Ken's sealed demon class. Ken reunites with Charlotte, who can now revive, and Dez, now a demonic mage with a Temptress secondary class. His grandmother warns that Kaiming survivors blame him for their fall. Elsewhere the UG president destroys Kaiming's last surface safe house, and its leader escapes into a dungeon vowing revenge on Ken, who is now level 25. At Halen the headmistress sets harsh new rules: second years must reach floor 32 for an inter-school raid competition or be expelled. Helen's mother, a woman known for her harem, joins the staff. On the descent, a dark panther that only Ken's blades can hurt kills him when Charlotte heals him, and Charlotte brings him back. Candace's party repeatedly fails the floor-25 mud boss. The panther returns, wounds the harem queen when she steps in, and kills Ken a second time; Helen revives him. Crimson finds the harem queen bloodied and Ken dead and beats her unconscious until Ken stops her, then lets slip that Portal can be shared through intimacy. With Crimson watching, Ken's party beats the mud boss, which drops muddy boots and a mace tipped with a ball of mud that Ken thinks of passing to Myrtle. The party reaches the floor-25 safe zone, which has human, dwarf and cat-people quarters. In the bath, Crimson begins telling them what she thinks the panther is.

Crimson tells her story. As a young scout she joined a new party built around a boastful berserker named Rick. On a candy floor, a lightning phoenix sent Rick into a rage. He killed the party's mage, and the phoenix killed the healer and Rick, while Crimson survived by feigning death. She kept Rick's CID because she blamed him, later learned to use a whip from a stone bear's drop, and killed the phoenix to gain Limit Break. She decides to train Ken until he can kill the panther, with Charlotte reviving him as often as needed. Amy brings orders from the grandparents to hunt Kaiming holdouts, and Crimson pushes a UG clerk into selling Ken the defensive skills Shadow Phase and Dodge. Crimson requires every student to beat the floor-25 boss ten times with ten different parties. The cat-people shaman turns up to teach diplomacy, exposes Ken's tattoo stats and Demon Lord class to the class, and joins Silverfangs. On a night raid against a Kaiming camp, Ken kills a soldier enhanced by a potion, and the panther kills him a third time. A captured man says Kaiming blames Ken for Gransman Industries and the failed Naga arrival, that another group waits on floor 31, and that the leader is in hiding. Fayeth executes him. Ken finds that his command can shut off Crimson's Limit Break, and they start calling the creature the smoke panther. After a clean boss run with Myrtle, Selene, Candace and Dez, Ken tells them that Kaiming killed his parents.

The shaman talks her way into Ken's suite and becomes a regular guest. She reads his tattoo, which marks him for a trial and counts down to the panther's next attack, and explains that cat-people who complete a dungeon trial gain great standing. In the safe-zone market a mob of mindless dwarf drones attacks Ken. The zone director, Selene's mother, tells him a dwarf has marked him and restricts his movements. At a tavern, Selene reveals that her father is the imprisoned man known as the Impaler, and senior students warn Ken that someone is hunting him. Crimson recruits an influencer Ken once met to run public relations for Silverfangs. In the panther's new second phase, time freezes and the fight becomes a speed race, and Ken loses and dies a fourth time. The shaman explains how dwarf queens, soldiers and drones work, and says the dwarves want Ken dead because the dungeon's attention signals his potential. The harem queen tells Ken that Helen only uses the "74 Wives" serial as cover to avoid her. A silver-haired elf courier brings letters from the princess and a very large trade payment, which Ken splits between the guild and his grandparents' recruiting. Crimson crushes three bounty hunters who break in, and alongside Director Amato she kills a gathering of would-be assassins tied to Kaiming. Amato's husband is revealed to be a UG undercover agent against Kaiming. Dwarves raid the safe zone and abduct people, and a soldier dwarf breaks Penny's shoulder before Ken forces him into the UG guards. Ken hires the influencer, and the cat-people elders hear his case. They judge that the dwarf queen threw away weak drones to hide a plot against him.

Back together as a full party, Ken's group clears floor 26, and Ken reaches level 26 and finishes his ten boss kills. He provokes the dungeon into sending the panther back, drinks a stack of stat potions, and wins its speed race. In the frozen time he sees more than a dozen Kaiming assassins about to ambush his party, led by the organization's top remaining member, whom Ken recognizes as the mage who fought his grandparents after the plane crash. The dead panther leaves a spellbook. Using its powers, Ken defeats the assassins with help from his party, freezes time, takes the leader's flasks, and kills him, which ends Kaiming and the vendetta over his parents. His long-held anger fades. The powers are named Liminal Speed, which builds speed with each strike, and Liminal Space, which spends that speed to stop time. Crimson reports that she killed every dwarf who entered the safe zone, and the class throws Ken a party. In UG tests run by Director Amato, the stacks only build from attacks meant to hurt living enemies, and Ken keeps pace with Crimson under her Limit Break and takes her CID in frozen time. Ken and Crimson become lovers. When he tries Absorb on her, Limit Break throws him through a wall, though Crimson afterward manages to open a portal. The UG rates the ability top tier with no cap. Fayeth and Charlotte tell Ken that Penny and Selene want a place with him, and that Penny's writing is about him. Ken says he remains committed to the elf princess.

In his mindscape, Ken meets the demon lord sealed inside him, Snoo-Snoo, and trades him magazines for a new skill, Delirious Pleasures, which Ken hides on his CID. Crimson finds a vampire-themed leveling spot on floor 28, portals into the harem queen's classroom, and explains that their rivalry began because people mixed the two of them up. Then, during class, a dwarf spear explodes against the window and thick smoke fills the school. Crimson leaves to help the UG, which dwarf teams have ambushed. Ken takes charge, using Eyes of Wisdom to spot enemies through the smoke, and with the harem queen he rescues Class B's room. The dwarves are quietly piling up unconscious upperclassmen. In the cafeteria, Ken and Helen kill a soldier dwarf, Charlotte and Bun-Bun revive the fallen, and Penny holds the line. The students win that fight without permanent losses. Director Amato determines that the main dwarf force is pushing up to floor 25 to take this branch of the dungeon and sends Crimson to block it. The shaman explains that her people have a pact with the dwarves not to fight each other. A dwarf army then marches out of the smoke. About a hundred Halen students form a tank line, two second-years die, and Penny and her healer Dolly kill an armored soldier.

Dwarves rush Dez's back line and blow themselves up, but Ken keeps his speed stacks. He spots the dwarf queen and tells the harem queen, whose name is Heather. She leaves him in charge of the students and flies off to face the nine-foot queen, who turns captured humans into drones and is guarded by five elite soldiers. Leaving Dez in command, Ken joins the fight and uses Heather's gladius to kill the dwarf healer. He then freezes time with Liminal Space, drives the gladius into a crack in the queen's armor, and moves Heather into position. Heather kills the queen, and the fortified building holds against the soldiers who remain. Ken loses his weapons and burns his hand on the gladius's mana, and Helen leads the students in a retreat when the healers run out of mana. At a UG meeting two days later, Heather and Amato shield Ken's ability, and his records are redacted like Crimson's. Ken buys a spellbook of armor-breaking strikes. Heather makes Helen apologize to Ken, gives him her gladius, a box of blades and her husbands' contacts, and says her husbands are coming out of retirement. Ken's grandparents arrive to hunt dwarves, forgive Crimson for Ken's injury, and accept her as his partner. The dwarf section is sealed with a fort after more than 200 adventurers died. Ken tells his grandparents Kaiming is finished, and they urge him to look ahead. Now level 29, he heals within a week, and Crimson opens a portal back to Halen so he can level for the raid.

characters.description: The first-person narrator, heir to the Nagato assassin clan and guildmaster of Silverfangs. In earlier adventures he survived a smoke-panther trial that granted him Liminal Speed, a skill that builds speed in stacks and can freeze time in proportion to them, and he became Crimson's lover. He helped bring down a dwarf queen and came away with a mana-burn injury to his arm, and his party also survived an attack by the remnants of the Kai Ming group.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: The Halen instructor in charge of Ken's class and his demanding trainer. She gained her Limit Break from a trial much like the one that gave Ken his speed, and she and Ken are now lovers, which lets her use his portal ability. She keeps up a long-running rivalry with Heather, the teacher of the neighboring class.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: Known as the Harem Queen, she teaches Class 2B, the class next door to Ken's, and is a rival of Crimson. In the previous book she killed an attacking dwarf queen with Ken's help, an encounter that left Ken with a mana-burn injury to his arm.
characters.name: Heather

characters.description: An elf and one of Ken's partners, serving as the main tank of his party. She expects to miss Harley now that the bard is spending most of her time with a separate healer group being formed for the coming raid.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: A demonic mage in Ken's party and one of his partners. Changes over the summer have altered her appearance, most visibly giving her pinker eyes. She is quick to scheme and makes no secret of her affection for Ken.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: A druid and the healer of Ken's party, close to him and protective of his health. She spent time fussing over the mana-burn injury to his arm, and her training over the break has left her noticeably more mature.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: A cat-person shaman who has taken to wearing human clothes. She has stepped into Harley's place in Ken's party and is performing well there as the class arrives for a large vampire-castle event on the 28th floor.
characters.name: Feline

characters.description: A pink-haired bard who is still technically a member of Ken's party but now spends most of her time with a three-person healer group. She is recruiting healers for that group so it can field its own party in the upcoming raid, a plan Ken supports.
characters.name: Harley

characters.description: A blue-haired Frost Knight in Ken's class who is clearly eager to see him again when the class gathers through Crimson's portal for the vampire-castle event on the 28th floor.
characters.name: Penny

characters.description: A student in Ken's class who reads entries from the dungeon almanac aloud as the class prepares for the vampire-castle event on the 28th floor.
characters.name: Candice

characters.description: The leader of the senior class, who joins the vampire-castle trip because rising graduation requirements push the seniors to keep out-leveling the second-years in Ken's class.
characters.name: Senior-class president

characters.description: A red-haired, winged tank in Ken's class who fights with a shield. When Ken rushes into the vampire boss's chamber alone and is nearly killed, she arrives with the others and takes a rapier strike that was aimed at him.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A classmate who mixes healing and damage, draining life from vampires and redirecting it to wounded allies. During the rescue of an overwhelmed group of seniors, she and Candice speak bluntly to the seniors about the risks they took.
characters.name: Selene

characters.description: A well-known social-media influencer who handles public relations for Silverfangs. Crimson brings her to the event camp, where she arrives with assistants and begins preparing Ken and Feline for media interviews, saying the image of the cat-people needs careful handling.
characters.name: Silverfangs PR lead

characters.description: Ken's masked, white-haired butler and a trained Nagato ninja. She delivers a letter from his grandparents asking him to scout a target and decide on a contract himself, then joins him as his pretend date for the job. She collects speed abilities, including a sprint and a teleport, and can switch between personas instantly.
characters.name: Amy

characters.description: The target named in the contract Ken's grandparents ask him to scout. He is recorded as a level 38 elemental fighter who styles himself king of the 30th-floor safe zone, and a small guild accuses him of taking its members' CIDs and inventories and acting like a warlord.
characters.name: The safe-zone ruler

characters.description: A tired but friendly administrator who greets Ken and Amy at the 30th-floor safe zone and guides them around. He says he has not left the zone in three years, and he shows them a village where few residents own CIDs or decent gear.
characters.name: Henry

characters.description: One of the two women seated with the safe-zone ruler. She keeps the trade records, runs the ruler's trade, and shows Ken and Amy to their room. She is eager to buy foam for filling the walls and does not appear to be held against her will.
characters.name: The bookkeeper

characters.description: The second woman at the safe-zone ruler's side. Her travel skill lets her turn into a whirlwind and carry others, so she serves as a kind of taxi for the household, and the ruler does not regard her as a planner.
characters.name: The whirlwind woman

characters.description: Charlotte's rabbit companion, who guards her closely and reacts to the jokes around him.
characters.name: Bun-Bun

characters.description: A handsome Royal Academy student, the son of an emir, who carries a saber and expensive gear. He steps in after Crimson injures a Royal Academy student who pointed at Ken, claims to have met Crimson before, and accuses Ken's group of leaning on her to farm crystals and win the raid competition.
characters.name: The prince

characters.description: The blonde class president of the Trusk school, a dragon summoner who calls herself the best summoner in the world and is adored by her classmates. A fan of the web serial about Ken's group, she challenges Ken to a wager on the college raid competition: if she wins he becomes her pet, and if he wins she becomes his dress-up doll.
characters.name: Trusk class president

characters.description: An old high-school acquaintance of Ken who is now a berserker with a mohawk-style haircut and the leader of his Pendulum class, a role he won by going berserk and beating his challengers. A friendly rival, he tells Ken about the upcoming DPS test and the betting already running on it.
characters.name: Pendulum class leader

characters.description: The Royal Academy's professor, one of three rival instructors Crimson confronts and beats. He holds the betting on the inter-school contest, bullies others, and cannot see Ken's UG stats because they are locked.
characters.name: Royal Academy professor

characters.description: The professor from the Pendulum college, one of the three rival instructors Crimson confronts and defeats after learning that the schools kept the betting on the contest hidden from her. Like the other two, he is unable to view Ken's UG stats, which are locked.
characters.name: Pendulum professor

characters.description: Ken's grandmother, a healer with a sadistic streak and an expert in torture who also works on CIDs. Brought in by portal after Ken's job in the safe zone, she and another grandmother crack the locked CIDs the party recovered and clear out the castle's server area.
characters.name: Yui

characters.description: Ken's grandfather, who arrives after the safe-zone job. He is fast and flirtatious, takes an immediate liking to Feline, and quizzes her about cat-person bodies based on what he has read in adult comics.
characters.name: Ken's grandfather

characters.description: The prince's bodyguard, a level 52 strength-based fighter with a history as a mass murderer. On the prince's order he crushes Ken's shoulder during their confrontation in the safe zone.
characters.name: George

characters.description: An elf princess with red hair who is Ken's wife by elven ritual and calls herself an empress. Warm toward Ken and commanding toward her guards, she agrees to join his class for the floor-32 raid despite her father's wish that she stay home.
characters.name: The elf princess

characters.description: The elf princess's aunt, a sensor who serves as her close guard. She is strong enough to break swords and keeps a careful watch over her niece.
characters.name: The princess's aunt

characters.description: A junior royal censor who is present with the elf princess at the Elven Palace and accompanies her among her guards.
characters.name: The junior royal censor

characters.description: An elf mercenary sensor at level 68, hired to spar with Ken at the Elven Palace. She relies on brute force, and her area shockwaves outlast his speed stacks and kill him before he is revived.
characters.name: Miriam

characters.description: A Pendulum berserker and Ken's old high-school friend who leads his class. In the DPS test he posts 1,271, likely helped by an extra healer and no tank. He was earlier seen surrounded by eight women at a safe-zone bar.
characters.name: Makin

characters.description: The president of the UG, a large summoner whose scars turn into winged warriors. He visits Ken's camp to brief the elves, reporting that the Naga have pulled back. Crimson mocks him as a coward for hanging back during an old raid, and he asks questions about the destroyed safe zone.
characters.name: UG president

characters.description: The narrator, a level 31 melee damage dealer who leads Class 2A of Halen into a 25-person raid on floor 32. His Liminal Speed skill builds attack-speed stacks, and its second phase can stop time for everyone else. He is Crimson's student and lover, and he heads the Silverfangs guild. He has a bet with the prince in which Crimson herself is the stake, and winning it could give Silverfangs a major lift.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: A powerful Halen instructor who trains Ken and is also his lover. She is missing from the floor-32 raid while she works elsewhere. The prince's bet with Ken names her as the prize, so the outcome of the raid matters to her directly.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: A demonic mage and ranged caster in Ken's raid, and one of the women closest to him. She speaks up about tactics from the first pull, suggesting that Helen should handle all the pulling.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: An elf tank who fights with a glaive and draws monster packs with a spore-based pull skill. She is the raid's best tank at controlling groups of enemies, and she is one of Ken's partners. She argues with Helen over who pulls, and the two agree to take turns.
characters.name: Fayeth

characters.description: A green-haired druid and healer in Ken's class who carries her rabbit, Bun-Bun, everywhere. She is one of the women close to Ken.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: Charlotte's rabbit companion, which she carries with her into the raid.
characters.name: Bun-Bun

characters.description: A cat-person shaman close to Ken, who calls him her mate. She formally joins the class raid, taking one of the two places left by classmates who quit, and with her the roster reaches its full 25.
characters.name: Feline

characters.description: A tall, blue-haired frost tank whom Ken counts among the classmates he trusts. She is the backup tank on the first boss. She praises Ken's result on the recent damage check and blushes around him.
characters.name: Penny

characters.description: A blonde arcane weaver who casts runes and keeps her uniform spotless. She is the raid's strategist and explains each boss's mechanics. She also holds the loot as the neutral keeper until payouts are decided. She sides with Ken on starting with the easiest quadrant.
characters.name: Candice

characters.description: A classmate who leads a group of healers in the floor-32 raid.
characters.name: Harley

characters.description: A winged paladin who tanks with a shield. She deals most of her damage when enemies attack her. She wants to open the raid in the middle quadrant and keeps clashing with Fayeth over pulling until they agree to alternate.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A healer whose style hurts enemies and heals the whole raid at the same time. In the necromancer fight she is the most efficient healer the class has. She also has a sharp, teasing sense of humor that she aims at her fellow healers.
characters.name: Selene

characters.description: A priest and healer in the raid. She is Penny's cousin and Harley's girlfriend. After the first wipe she argues that Harley should be revived first, since Harley restores the healers' mana.
characters.name: Meredith

characters.description: An elven royal in Ken's class and one of the women close to him. She stays out of classroom disputes and enjoys the break from court politics that the raid gives her.
characters.name: The elf princess

characters.description: An arrogant young man whom Ken has met several times. He made a bet with Ken in which Crimson is the stake, and he treats Ken as a rival.
characters.name: The prince

characters.description: A Class C professor from Halen who supervises the class's floor-32 raid while Crimson is away. No high-level tanks or healers come along this time, and her job is to make sure fallen students are revived after a wipe.
characters.name: Halen Class C professor

characters.description: A top-level elven royal censor who guards Ken at the princess's request. She spars with him while Candice records data, and he beats her only after his Liminal Speed builds up. Afterward she points out that an assassin should not be expected to win a fair fight.
characters.name: The chief royal censor

characters.description: An enchanter in Ken's class who mostly buffs the tanks and supports the healers. Ken and Candice decide the raid has more healing than it needs and want her to buff the melee damage dealers.
characters.name: Kendra

characters.description: Ken's grandfather and an elder of the Nagato clan. He arrives at the dungeon with Ken's three grandmothers and reports that the princess's business through Silverfangs has made the family billionaires. He tests Ken with a surprise attack, then joins him for a meal in his tent.
characters.name: Ken's grandfather

characters.description: One of Ken's three grandmothers. She is known for a sadistic streak. She comes to the dungeon with Ken's grandfather and the other grandmothers and visits Ken's camp.
characters.name: Yui

characters.description: The berserker who leads the Pendulum college's group. When an earthquake cuts the dungeon off, he joins Ken, the professors and the prince to plan a route to the floor-30 safe zone.
characters.name: Pendulum berserker

characters.description: A male professor from the Royal College who sits in on the leaders' meeting after the earthquake, when the colleges plan how to reach the floor-30 safe zone and restore contact.
characters.name: Royal College professor

characters.description: A senior elven royal censor whose mercenary class grows stronger as she earns money. The Emperor once expelled her and put a bounty on her, and she worked underground as Madam Root before recently returning to the censors. She runs a network of informants among human adventurers and is immensely strong.
characters.name: Older royal censor

characters.description: A younger elven royal censor who can move through darkness at speed, taking one passenger with her. After the dungeon shifts and cuts her off from the princess, she and the older censor decide to push as deep as they can to reach her.
characters.name: Junior royal censor

characters.description: A black-haired Royal College student in gold jewelry who is a distant relative of the SJS family. She comes to Ken offering to throw her college's raid attempt and to give testimony if he protects her, but she refuses to be recorded. Ken declines her offer.
characters.name: Royal College student

characters.description: The leader of the Trusk college's class and an ally of Ken on the stranded colleges' council. With Pendulum and Ken, she votes to leave the raid when food runs low. Her college's summoners had earlier hidden the raid entrance under sand.
characters.name: Trusk class leader

characters.description: A dwarf queen of roughly level 50. Trusk scouts report that she leads around 500 dwarves in an assault on the Naga, who are defending the floor-35 boss door and the way into the safe zone. She stands between the alliance and safety.
characters.name: Dwarf queen

characters.description: A demon sealed inside Ken, carried over from earlier books.
characters.name: The demon sealed in Ken

characters.description: The demon sealed inside Ken, who says he was once third in line for the Demon Lord throne. When Ken meets a floor boss in his likeness, the demon breaks his chains in Ken's mind. He admits he was steering Ken to spare the prince so that he could take the prince's body, with Ken's as a fallback. Freed from the seal, he becomes the boss and vows to claim Ken's body.
characters.name: Snoo-Snoo

characters.description: A winged, angel-like woman who works as the governor's assistant in the vast city found below the boss floor, which she calls Star City. A language skill lets her speak English, which another human living in the city taught her.
characters.name: Winged guide

characters.description: Ken's nickname for Star City's winged guide, since he cannot pronounce her real name. She explains how the city came to be inside the dungeon and who lives there, then leads Ken to Crimson before going her own way.
characters.name: Lulu

characters.description: The governor of Star City, a tall, high-level, green-skinned man in a silk shirt with a monocle and gold-capped tusks. Ken offends him by calling him an orc and then bows, and the governor welcomes the party.
characters.name: Star City governor

characters.description: The head of the UG. The princess says he has assured her that the earlier attempt on her life will not be repeated.
characters.name: UG president

characters.description: The narrator and heir of the Nagato clan, a human whose incubus form was granted by the dungeon, although Star City assumes he was born a demon. An Emperor-class melee fighter, he ends a summer of private gravity-chamber training with Crimson exhausted and aware that he still trails the strongest fighters. Before leaving the chamber he agrees to a future duel with a young orc-like warrior who mocks him as a little demon.
characters.name: Ken

characters.description: The strongest human, a Halen instructor, and Ken's lover and private trainer. Since the Naga attack and humanity's arrival in Star City she has quietly pushed her own training harder. She passes on research suggesting one day of diving for every four of training, and reminds Ken that his grandmother expects the clan heir to train with the new recruits.
characters.name: Crimson

characters.description: A young warrior of the orc-like race that dominates Star City, belonging to one of the city's guilds. He shoulders past Ken outside the gravity chamber, calls him a little demon, and demands proof of strength, drawing Ken into an agreement to duel him in the gravity chambers at a later date.
characters.name: Orc-like guild fighter

characters.description: A young cat-person shaman, son of his clan's chief shaman. His grandmother, the clan's elder shaman, died fighting an incubus in an earlier dispute, and his sister lies unconscious in the healing ward still believing the grandmother lived. Lucian despises incubi, and with his father's quiet encouragement he starts looking for indirect ways to strike at the incubus, such as leaving him unable to pay the fine the arbiters imposed.
characters.name: Lucian

characters.description: Chief shaman of Lucian's clan, a cold and formidable figure around level 90 or higher. He tells his son that the orc-like arbiters found both sides at fault in the clash that killed the clan's elder shaman, so only a fine applies. Unable to move openly, he hints that Lucian should work through others and make the incubus unable to pay.
characters.name: Lucian's father

characters.description: Lucian's sister, lying in a coma in her clan's healing ward. She believes their grandmother survived the fight with the incubus, and Lucian lets her keep that belief. She is the family member he plainly cares for, in contrast to their cold parents.
characters.name: Lucian's sister

characters.description: Ken's grandfather, an aging swordsman who fights with a sword of light. He welcomes Ken home with a surprise attack, and Ken, now his equal or slightly better in speed, beats him using liminal space. Playful and secretly glad to see his grandson, he is teased by the household about his several wives and a hidden stash.
characters.name: Ken's grandfather

characters.description: Ken's masked, white-haired servant, a butler with the manner of a ninja, returning from earlier books. When Ken comes home Ami walks him through the rebuilt Nagato clan and explains the many young recruits who have joined it.
characters.name: Ami

characters.description: One of Ken's partners and a member of his party. She comes from a warlock family with demon blood, became a demon herself in the previous book, and now fights as a demonic mage with a heart-shaped pupil. She joins Ken in greeting guests at the clan's welcome feast and swaps summer stories with Penny and Charlotte.
characters.name: Dez

characters.description: A white-haired, blue-striped shaman of the spirit tiger tribe and a member of Ken's party. Her people split from the main cat-person clans long ago and worship the dungeon, which tribes devoted to the goddess Neko regard as heresy. A clan kidnapped her after the shuffle. Her CID functions through her rituals.
characters.name: Feline

characters.description: Ken's partner and the party's healer, owner of the dungeon monster Bun-Bun. She has become more confident and bolder in public over the summer. During the clan's welcome feast she helps out in the kitchen with Penny before joining the others.
characters.name: Charlotte

characters.description: One of Ken's companions and the party's tank, who has grown as strong as her own father over the summer. She helps in the kitchen at the clan's welcome feast and compares summers with Charlotte and Dez.
characters.name: Penny

characters.description: Charlotte's pet, a dungeon monster roughly as strong as Charlotte herself. He ambushes Ken at the welcome feast and is handled with good humor.
characters.name: Bun-Bun

characters.description: Helen's mother, a powerful human adventurer widely known as the harem queen, reported to be in the upper 60s in level. She is actively pursuing information about trials, with Helen accompanying her.
characters.name: Harem queen

characters.description: A red-haired paladin in Ken's class at Halen and the daughter of the harem queen. She spent the summer training with her mother and remains openly hostile toward Ken, even while trading gossip with him and Harley before class.
characters.name: Helen

characters.description: A pink-haired bard in Ken's class who jokes about wanting a harem of healers and is always eager to pry into gossip.
characters.name: Harley
